review:
Two Mexican holidays in one game: Cinco de Mayo in the base game, Día de Muertos in the bonus, on a 7x7 grid. Five or more touching symbols pay and refill, and the refills keep going while wins keep forming.

Surprise progressive multipliers can attach to wins in the base game, and three sugar-skull scatters open the Día de Muertos bonus, which adds even more multiplier action. Very high volatility, 5,000x max, excellent 97% RTP. Free spins about once every 269 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
